name: Achi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Achi village emblem in white: an outlined six-pointed star bearing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Achi, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Achi village emblem — an outlined six-pointed star bearing a stylised character
